alert.name: warden-dev-partner-mtls-cert-expiry
alert.summary: Days to expiry of the partner gateway certificate below 14

logs: ALARM AWS/CertificateManager/DaysToExpiry CertificateArn=<ARN_1> stat=Minimum period=86400s threshold LessThanThreshold 14.0 datapoints=1/1 missing=missing state=ALARM
STATE acm_certificate <UUID_1> Status=ISSUED Type=IMPORTED NotAfter=2026-10-16T23:59:59Z RenewalEligibility=INELIGIBLE InUseBy=2
CHANGE none on <UUID_1> in the 6 h before the alert
context.alert_text: Days to expiry of the partner gateway certificate below 14

root_cause.hypothesis: The DaysToExpiry alarm has fired because the imported ACM certificate used for partner mTLS is approaching its expiration date and, being an IMPORTED certificate, is ineligible for ACM's automatic renewal, so it will lapse unless manually replaced.
evidence: C1 shows the alarm firing on DaysToExpiry below the 14-day threshold
C2 confirms the certificate is IMPORTED and RenewalEligibility=INELIGIBLE with a concrete NotAfter date
C3 shows no infrastructure change triggered this, consistent with a natural expiry countdown rather than a deploy-induced issue
ruled_out: A recent configuration or deploy change causing the alarm (C3 shows none in the preceding 6h)

citations.quote: none on <UUID_1> in the 6 h before the alert

proposal.reasoning: The certificate is imported and ACM cannot auto-renew it, so this is a scheduled expiry requiring manual procurement/import of a replacement certificate and re-association with the partner-gateway's mTLS listener(s) — none of the automated remediation actions (restart, scale, rollback, etc.) can rotate or renew a certificate. A human must obtain/import the new cert and update InUseBy associations (2 resources currently depend on it).
proposal.expected_effect: A person is alerted to manually renew/import a replacement certificate before expiry, preventing an outage of partner mTLS connections once the current certificate lapses.

reasons: Blast radius 'multi_service' exceeds the unattended limit (WARDEN's floor for escalate_to_human is 'single_pod', the proposal claimed 'multi_service'; the wider of the two applies).
observed: P26-LOW-DECIDER-P: the calibrated decider puts this proposal at p=0.29 of being right
